question: What is the per-vendor adapter maintenance cost? Enumerate the vendor-specific surfaces (prompt transport, tool and permission model, output schema, progress/streaming, timeout, session state, model naming) and estimate each surface's change frequency from OBSERVED vendor release cadence over a stated window - then state which surfaces must be versioned to avoid breaking on a vendor update.

window.reason: Codex GitHub pagination returned 400 newest releases whose oldest published_at is 2026-03-13. Using a longer window would undercount Codex CLI cadence. API notes exist earlier; those earlier dates are cited only when marked in_observation_window=false.

headline_numbers.name: anthropic_api_dated_headings_in_window
headline_numbers.derivation: Count of '### Month D, YYYY' headings in the frozen Anthropic API release notes whose parsed date is inside the window. Measure A uses datetime.strptime; measure B uses a month-name dict. A=54 B=54.

headline_numbers.name: openai_api_dated_entries_in_window
headline_numbers.derivation: Count of 'Mon DD' entries under '### Month, YYYY' headings in the frozen OpenAI changelog whose reconstructed date is inside the window. Entry parser=42; day-header recount=42.

headline_numbers.name: surfaces_that_must_be_versioned
headline_numbers.derivation: Seven catalog surfaces; each has at least one dated vendor note showing a wire-format, id, or numeric-budget change that would break an unversioned adapter.

remeasure.policy: Re-measure once with a mechanically different probe (different field). If the two readings disagree, report BLOCKED with both numbers rather than picking one.

claude_code_github_releases.note: These two GitHub timestamp fields disagree by one release (138 vs 137). Per retry policy this cadence is NOT picked; both numbers are reported. It is not a headline.

codex_github_releases.note: 400/400 agree, but this is CLI binary cadence (several per day), not adapter-surface breakage. Not used as a surface rate.

surfaces.why_version: SDK HTTP client class and regional request host are load-bearing adapter fields. A pinned transport version keeps httpx vs httpx2 and un-prefixed vs prefixed hosts from silently swapping.

error_band.note: Curated counts are ±1 event. Keyword hits over-count model launch notes that mention tools/streaming incidentally and are not used as the rate.

API customers can select regional processing per request via a prefixed domain plus a Global-geography project key.
Cache diagnostics launched in public beta on the Claude API (prompt-cache observability).

In-window Anthropic notes did not repeat that rename; the 2026-01-29 GA is cited as outside-window evidence, not counted in the in-window rate.

forecast.falsifiable_statement: Between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-22 inclusive, Anthropic API release notes or the OpenAI API changelog will publish at least one new GA model id (claude-* or gpt-*) OR retire/error an existing GA model id. If neither source records such an event in that window, this forecast is FALSE.
forecast.basis: In the 165-day observation window the frozen notes record multiple GA launches (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 mini/nano) and multiple retirements (Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4, Opus 4, Haiku 3). That is more than one naming event per month. The 90-day forecast is the same cadence, not a new mechanism.

Named surface with falsifiable next-break forecast and confidence band

evidence.claim: Anthropic API release notes in the window contain 54 dated headings, confirmed by two parsers.
OpenAI API changelog in the window contains 42 dated entries, confirmed by entry splitter and day-header recount.
Claude Code GitHub published_at vs created_at counts in the window agree.
A6 DESIGN.json was read and used as the adapter contract for this cost model.
All seven catalog surfaces must be versioned on the A6 adapter.

residual_unknowns: Keyword classifier over-counts; curated rates are the ones to price against.
Claude Code GitHub published_at (138) vs created_at (137) disagreed; CLI cadence not used as a headline.
Codex GitHub history before 2026-03-13 was not in the 400-release retrieve; NOT-CHECKED.
Per-hour engineering cost to absorb a surface change was not measured (no timesheets); NOT-CHECKED.
answer: Over 2026-03-13..2026-08-24 (165 days, notes retrieved 2026-08-24) the frozen Anthropic API notes carry 54 dated headings and the OpenAI changelog 42 dated entries. All seven catalog surfaces must be versioned: model_naming is the hottest (multiple GA launches and retirements), then tool_permission_model (computer_toolset_20260801 and permission_policy), then session_state and progress_streaming (removed compaction_control; event_deltas). output_schema had only one in-window OpenAI mention; the Anthropic output_format->output_config.format rename is 2026-01-29 (outside window) and is still a version pin. Timeout has the fewest notes (90s cell limit, httpx2 Timeout, 429 spend caps) but the constants still need a pin. Claude Code GitHub cadence is reported as published_at=138 vs created_at=137 and is not picked. Forecast: model_naming will see another GA id or retirement by 2026-11-22 (confidence 0.65-0.90).
